['Basell Polyolefine GmbH '].company_description: Basell Polyolefine GmbH is a company that operates in the area of polyolefins, which are a type of polymer produced from simple olefins such as ethylene and propylene. The company offers a range of polyolefin products, including polyethylene and polypropylene, which are used in various industries such as packaging, automotive, construction, and healthcare.

['ALSO Deutschland GmbH '].company_description: ALSO Deutschland GmbH operates in the information and communications technology (ICT) industry, focusing on information technology (IT), consumer electronics (CE), and telecommunication products. The company cooperates with hardware and software manufacturers and provides additional services in value-added sectors, such as high-end servers.
